title: What we track and why
intro: Four short answers, in plain words.

lines.label: What the board reads from Discord
lines.what: Your display name, your avatar, your guild roles, and the builds you confirm.
lines.why: To show you as yourself, put you in the right guild, and keep your build on your own sheet.

lines.label: What is stored
lines.what: Your Discord id, your name, your builds, your sign-ups and your saved settings. Questions you ask Leeroy are kept too.
lines.why: So the board remembers you between visits and your guild sees one up-to-date sheet.

lines.label: Who can see it
lines.what: Members of your own guild see your name, builds and sign-ups. Guild admins run the board. Nobody sees it for ads, and we do not sell it.
lines.why: A guild board only works if the guild can see who is coming and with what.

lines.label: How to delete it
lines.what: You will be able to erase your data yourself, in one step.
lines.why: It is your data, so you should be able to take it back.
